programme.desc: Chef Primo and businessman Secondo are immigrant brothers from Italy who open their dream restaurant, Paradise, in New Jersey. However, Primo's authentic food is too unfamiliar for the local tastes, and the restaurant is struggling. When famous Italian-American bandleader Louis Prima is scheduled to appear at Paradise, the two brothers put all of their efforts into the important meal, which will likely decide the fate of their restaurant. - Minnie Driver, Ian Holm, Isabella Rossellini, Tony Shalhoub, Stanley Tucci (Drama)

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire. - Nicole Kidman, James Franco, Robert Pattinson, Damian Lewis, Jenny Agutter (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: The sweeping expanses of the Sahara are the setting for a passionate love affair in this adaptation of Michael Ondaatje's novel. A badly burned man, Laszlo de Almasy (Ralph Fiennes), is tended to by a nurse, Hana (Juliette Binoche), in an Italian monastery near the end of World War II. His past is revealed through flashbacks involving a married Englishwoman (Kristin Scott Thomas) and his work mapping the African landscape. Hana learns to heal her own scars as she helps the dying man. - Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche, Willem Dafoe, Kristin Scott Thomas, Naveen Andrews (Romance, War, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery. - Naomi Watts, Martin Henderson, David Dorfman, Brian Cox, Jane Alexander (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul. - Naomi Watts, Simon Baker, David Dorfman, Elizabeth Perkins, Gary Cole (Horror, Thriller, Mystery)

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

programme.title: Pootie Tang
programme.desc: Although he speaks an indecipherable language, a superhero (Lance Crouther) protects children from a mogul (Jennifer Coolidge) who encourages smoking, drinking and eating fast food.

programme.title: The Boys Are Back
programme.desc: Still reeling from the death of his wife, a man (Clive Owen) adopts an unconventional method of raising his two sons.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: Iris finds her comfortable New York City life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past.

programme.title: American Son
programme.desc: A freshly graduated Marine returns home to his dysfunctional family for Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Expend4bles
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VII -- The New Blood
programme.desc: A psychic teen's (Lar Park Lincoln) psychiatrist (Terry Kiser) sends her and her mother (Susan Blu) to Crystal Lake, home of hockey-masked Jason.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
programme.desc: Hockey-masked slasher Jason (Kane Hodder) follows a Crystal Lake teen (Jensen Daggett) and her friends on a cruise to New York.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies.

programme.title: The Presidio
programme.desc: An Army provost marshal (Sean Connery) clashes with a detective (Mark Harmon) over a murder at the San Francisco military base.

programme.title: The Dutchman
programme.desc: Haunted by his crumbling marriage and an identity crisis, a successful but troubled businessman gets drawn into a psychological game of cat and mouse with a sinister, mysterious woman whom he encounters on a New York subway.

programme.title: Paid in Full
programme.desc: A dry cleaner's delivery boy becomes one of the most powerful drug dealers in the 1980s Harlem. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Flight
programme.desc: Commercial airline pilot Whip Whitaker (Denzel Washington) has a problem with drugs and alcohol, though so far he's managed to complete his flights safely. His luck runs out when a disastrous mechanical malfunction sends his plane hurtling toward the ground. Whip pulls off a miraculous crash-landing that results in only six lives lost. Shaken to the core, Whip vows to get sober -- but when the crash investigation exposes his addiction, he finds himself in an even worse situation. - Denzel Washington, Don Cheadle, Kelly Reilly, John Goodman, Bruce Greenwood (Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: One of an elite group of assassins, Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) may be the best in the business. Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership. - Jason Statham, Ben Foster, Donald Sutherland, Tony Goldwyn, Jeff Chase (Action, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: The General's Daughter
programme.desc: When the body of Army Capt. Elizabeth Campbell (Leslie Stefanson) is found on a Georgia military base, two investigators, Warrant Officers Paul Brenner (John Travolta) and Sara Sunhill (Madeleine Stowe), are ordered to solve her murder. What they uncover is anything but clear-cut. Unseemly details emerge about Campbell's life, leading to allegations of a possible military cover-up of her death and the involvement of her father, Lt. Gen. Joseph Campbell (James Cromwell). - John Travolta, Madeleine Stowe, James Cromwell, Timothy Hutton, Leslie Stefanson (Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Expend4bles
programme.desc: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table. - Jason Statham, Sylvester Stallone, Andy Garcia, Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson, Megan Fox (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Hard Eight
programme.desc: A stranger (Philip Baker Hall) mentors a young Reno gambler (John C. Reilly) who weds a hooker (Gwyneth Paltrow) and befriends a vulgar casino regular. - Philip Baker Hall, John C. Reilly, Gwyneth Paltrow, Samuel L. Jackson, F. William Parker (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business. - Marlon Brando, Al Pacino, James Caan, Richard Castellano, Robert Duvall (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Godfather, Part II
programme.desc: The compelling sequel to "The Godfather," contrasting the life of Corleone father and son. Traces the problems of Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) in 1958 and that of a young immigrant Vito Corleone (Robert De Niro) in 1917's Hell's Kitchen. Michael survives many misfortunes and Vito is introduced to a life of crime. - Al Pacino, Robert Duvall, Diane Keaton, Robert De Niro, John Cazale (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Godfather, Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: As Michael Corleone (Al Pacino) ages, he finds that being the head of the Corleone crime family isn't getting any easier. He wants his family out of the Mafia, but the mob kingpin (Eli Wallach) isn't eager to let one of the most powerful and wealthy families go legit. Making matters even worse is Michael's nephew, Vincent (Andy Garcia). Not only does Vincent want a piece of the Corleone family's criminal empire, but he also wants Michael's daughter, Mary (Sofia Coppola). - Al Pacino, Diane Keaton, Talia Shire, Andy Garcia, Eli Wallach (Crime drama)

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Antonio Banderas, Jet Li, Wesley Snipes (Action, Thriller, Adventure)

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Boozy writer Marty (Colin Farrell) is a man in search of a screenplay. He has a catchy title but no story to go along with it. Marty has a couple of oddball buddies, Hans (Christopher Walken) and Billy (Sam Rockwell), who make a living by kidnapping rich people's dogs, then returning them and collecting the reward. However, this time, the fur flies when Hans and Billy kidnap the beloved pooch of a gangster (Woody Harrelson), and Marty uses the ensuing events as fodder for his screenplay. - Colin Farrell, Christopher Walken, Sam Rockwell, Woody Harrelson, Abbie Cornish (Dark comedy)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: Strange Wilderness
programme.desc: Peter Gaulke takes over when his father, a respected wildlife TV host, dies, but receives far less success. When the show is threatened with cancellation, Peter and his know-nothing crew of stoners and idiots realize that only one creature can save the show: Bigfoot. - Steve Zahn, Allen Covert, Jonah Hill, Ashley Scott, Harry Hamlin (Comedy)

programme.title: Virtuosity
programme.desc: A former cop who has been imprisoned for murdering the psychopath who killed his family, Parker Barnes (Denzel Washington) is recruited to test out a new virtual-reality program where the goal is to apprehend a computer-generated being called SID 6.7 (Russell Crowe), who has been modeled on hundreds of deranged criminals. When SID manages to escape into the real world, Barnes must capture or destroy him before the soulless entity can go on a killing spree. - Denzel Washington, Kelly Lynch, Russell Crowe, Stephen Spinella, William Forsythe (Action)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure. - Michael C. Pitt, Joe Pesci, Ron Perlman, Steve Buscemi, Nicolette Robinson (Drama)

programme.title: Kinky Boots
programme.desc: After his father's demise, Charlie Price inherits the family business, a shoe factory in Northampton, England. He is not interested in shoes, and the factory is in such dire financial straits that he must lay off 15 employees. However, a fortuitous encounter with a transvestite cabaret singer inspires Charlie to save the factory from closure by producing erotic footwear, much to the chagrin of the workers. - Joel Edgerton, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Sarah-Jane Potts, Jemima Rooper, Linda Bassett (Comedy drama, LGBTQ, Music)

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: New York City writer Iris finds her comfortable, solitary life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life. - Naomi Watts, Bill Murray, Ann Dowd, Constance Wu, Sarah Pidgeon (Drama)

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: A low-level Washington, D.C., public servant, Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), is thrust into the national spotlight when he's asked by Martin Geller (Dylan Baker), the head of the Democratic Party, to run for president after the party's presidential and vice-presidential nominees are killed in a plane crash. The odds are against Gilliam, mostly because he has a penchant for telling the truth about what is wrong with the country. Remarkably, his straight-talking style catches on with the public. - Chris Rock, Bernie Mac, Dylan Baker, Nick Searcy, Lynn Whitfield (Comedy)

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium. - Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham, Jet Li, Dolph Lundgren, Chuck Norris (Action, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: While traveling to California, Taylor and his wife, Amy, experience a vehicle malfunction on a remote highway. Amy Taylor accepts a ride from a truck driver to seek assistance while Jeff Taylor remains with the vehicle. When the couple fails to reunite at a designated location, Jeff Taylor begins a search for his wife despite a lack of assistance from local residents or law enforcement. - Kurt Russell, J.T. Walsh, Kathleen Quinlan, M.C. Gainey, Jack Noseworthy (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: Holden and Banky are best friends and authors of a popular comic book. Holden falls in love with Alyssa, who happens to be a lesbian. Holden's relationship with Alyssa strains his life-long friendship with Banky, and soon the relationship between Holden and Alyssa has problems when he cannot deal with her past. - Ben Affleck, Joey Lauren Adams, Jason Lee, Dwight Ewell, Jason Mewes (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ, Drama)

programme.title: Snag
programme.desc: A lone wolf's quiet existence gets shattered when he learns that the woman he once loved and thought was dead is alive and being held captive by ruthless gangsters. Now, to take on this dangerous criminal organization, he must seek out allies and storm into a world of violence to rescue the love of his life. - Ben Milliken, Jaime Camil, Jonny Beauchamp, David Zayas, Sofía Castro (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Texas Rangers
programme.desc: Texas, 1875. In a land without justice, where chaos reigns, one legendary man, Leander McNelly (Dylan McDermott), is chosen to lead a group of unlikely heroes. These young men, out-manned and out-gunned, must battle an army of renegade outlaws led by the ruthless John King Fisher (Alfred Molina). Sworn to protect the innocent and the women they love (Rachael Leigh Cook), (Leonor Varela), the Rangers risk their lives to put the wrong things right in their beloved homeland. - James Van Der Beek, Dylan McDermott, Usher Raymond, Ashton Kutcher, Robert Patrick (Western, Adventure)

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: A teen bounty hunter is torn between helping or capturing a seductive fugitive bank robber hiding in his small town during the Great Depression.

programme.title: 68 Kill
programme.desc: A hardworking man's inability to say no to a beautiful woman gets him in trouble when he agrees to steal $68,000.

programme.title: Aeon Flux
programme.desc: In the last city on Earth, underground rebels dispatch their top assassin (Charlize Theron) to kill a government leader.

programme.title: Star Trek: Section 31
programme.desc: Emperor Philippa Georgiou faces the sins of her past after joining a secret division of Starfleet that's tasked with protecting the United Federation of Planets.

programme.title: Snag
programme.desc: After learning the woman he once loved is being held captive by ruthless gangsters, a lone wolf seeks out allies and storms into a world of violence to rescue her.

programme.title: The Longest War
programme.desc: The human stories and drama behind America's involvement in Afghanistan, now the longest war in U.S. history; features interviews with intelligence operatives, soldiers, families, Afghan officials, journalists, and government and military officials.

programme.title: The Cut
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: An account of the 101st Airborne Division's 10-day struggle to secure a strategic mountainside in South Vietnam.

programme.title: Eagle Eye
programme.desc: Two strangers (Shia LaBeouf, Michelle Monaghan) become pawns of a mysterious woman who threatens their friends and family and uses technology to control their actions.

programme.title: Face/Off
programme.desc: An FBI agent (John Travolta) and his nemesis (Nicolas Cage) trade physical identities.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: A lieutenant colonel and approximately 400 U.S. troops battle 2,000 North Vietnamese soldiers in 1965.

programme.title: Defiance
programme.desc: In 1941, Nazi soldiers are slaughtering Eastern European Jews by the thousands. Three brothers, Tuvia (Daniel Craig), Zus (Liev Schreiber) and Asael (Jamie Bell), manage to escape and take refuge in the forest where they played in childhood. Seeking a way to avenge the deaths of their loved ones, the brothers turn their daily struggle for survival into a battle against the Nazis. As news of their exploits spreads, others join the fray, willing to risk their lives for even brief freedom. - Daniel Craig, Liev Schreiber, Jamie Bell, Alexa Davalos, Allan Corduner (Historical drama, War)

programme.title: The Last Stop in Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a traveling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune. - Jim Cummings, Jocelin Donahue, Sierra McCormick, Nicholas Logan, Michael Abbott Jr. (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Strange Wilderness
programme.desc: Peter Gaulke takes over when his father, a respected wildlife TV host, dies, but receives far less success. When the show is threatened with cancellation, Peter and his know-nothing crew of stoners and idiots realize that only one creature can save the show: Bigfoot. - Steve Zahn, Allen Covert, Jonah Hill, Ashley Scott, Harry Hamlin (Comedy)

programme.title: Attica
programme.desc: During the summer of 1971, tensions between inmates and guards at the Attica Correctional Facility are at an all-time high. On the morning of Sept. 9, it all comes to a head as Attica becomes the stage for one of the largest U.S. prison riots ever. (Documentary)

programme.title: The Girl in the Pool
programme.desc: A man's life collapses when his mistress is found dead in his pool. Terrified of the consequences and desperate to protect his family, he conceals the truth, triggering a chaotic night that threatens to unravel his perfect life. - Freddie Prinze Jr., Monica Potter, Kevin Pollak, Tyler Lawrence Gray, Brielle Barbusca (Thriller)

programme.title: Disgraced
programme.desc: An examination of the events surrounding the 2003 murder of Baylor University men's basketball star Patrick Dennehy. (Documentary)

programme.title: 16 Shots
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer is charged with murder after the shooting of Laquan McDonald. - Anita Alvarez, Dean Angelo, Alma Benitez, Pat Camden, Charlene Carruthers (Documentary)

programme.title: Bang Bang
programme.desc: Following Bang Bang Rozyski, an eccentric retired pugilist obsessed with rectifying the sins of his past. - Tim Blake Nelson, Glenn Plummer, Andrew Liner, Kevin Corrigan, Nina Arianda (Drama)

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma. - Ryan Phillippe, Abbie Cornish, Channing Tatum, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Ciarán Hinds (Drama, War)

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: In February and March 1945, U.S. troops fight and win one of the most crucial and costly battles of the war on the island of Iwo Jima. A photo of U.S. servicemen raising the flag on Mount Suribachi becomes an iconic symbol of victory to a war-weary nation. The individuals themselves become heroes, though not all survive the war and realize it. - Ryan Phillippe, Jesse Bradford, Adam Beach, John Benjamin Hickey, John Slattery (War, Historical drama)

programme.title: The Sum of All Fears
programme.desc: Based on Tom Clancy's novel, this espionage thriller tracks a sinister plot to draw the United States and Russia into World War III. When the Russian president (Ciarán Hinds) suddenly dies, world tension escalates. Coupled with missing nuclear scientists and the threat of a nuclear detonation on United States soil, young CIA analyst Jack Ryan (Ben Affleck) must uncover who is behind the conspiracy. - Ben Affleck, Morgan Freeman, James Cromwell, Liev Schreiber, Bridget Moynahan (Thriller, Action, Drama, War)

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career. (Documentary, Comedy)

programme.title: Vacation
programme.desc: Remembering fond, childhood memories of his trip to Walley World, Rusty Griswold surprises his wife and two sons with a cross-country excursion to America's favorite fun park. Following in his father's footsteps, Rusty and the gang pack up the car and hit the road for some much-needed family bonding. Soon, the promise of fun turns into one misadventure after another for the next generation of Griswolds and anyone who encounters them. - Ed Helms, Christina Applegate, Skyler Gisondo, Steele Stebbins, Chris Hemsworth (Comedy, Adventure)

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. - Zach Galifianakis, Owen Wilson, Kristen Wiig, Ross Kimball, Devin Ratray (Comedy, Action)

programme.title: Eddie Murphy Raw
programme.desc: Recorded in front of a live audience in New York City, this film features actor/comedian Eddie Murphy performing a scathing comedy routine. Eddie's uncle (Samuel L. Jackson) and other family members are lampooned in sketch segments, while Murphy largely sticks to stand-up, riffing on fellow black comedians, marriage and various racial and ethnic stereotypes, among many other topics. The concert is particularly renowned for Murphy's liberal and unrepentant use of expletives. - Tatyana Ali, Samuel L. Jackson, Deon Richmond (Comedy)

programme.title: Erotic Alien Encounter
programme.desc: A humanoid alien named David gets stranded on Earth and is befriended by a beautiful nurse named Kate. With help from her best friend, Kate is determined to help David return to his home planet before government agents get to him first. (Adults only, Erotic)

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making. - Robert De Niro, Tommy Lee Jones, Morgan Freeman, Zach Braff, Emile Hirsch (Comedy)

programme.title: Pootie Tang
programme.desc: Adapted from a comedy sketch on HBO's The Chris Rock Show, Pootie Tang (Lance Crouther) is the ultimate superhero. A cool-walking, smooth-talking lady's man, Pootie is a hero and a role model to all the kids of the neighborhood. Everybody looks up to Pootie except evil Dick Lecter (Robert Vaughn), CEO of Lecter Corp., a company that makes cigarettes, alcohol and fast food. Pootie shows cool determination and strength to prevail over Lecter and his minions. - Lance Crouther, Jennifer Coolidge, Wanda Sykes, Robert Vaughn, Chris Rock (Comedy, Musical, Adventure, Action)

programme.title: Just Another Immigrant: Romesh at the Greek
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan, a successful comedian in England, moves his entire family to Los Angeles to make it as a comedian in America; he then takes the drastic step of performing his first ever U.S. stand-up show at the historic Greek Theatre. (Special, Comedy, Standup)

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (Action, Adventure, Drama, Romance)

programme.title: Good Mourning
programme.desc: A movie star must choose between pursuing his one true love or landing a life-changing role in a film. - Colson Baker, Mod Sun, Becky G, Dove Cameron, Pete Davidson (Comedy)

programme.title: Borg vs. McEnroe
programme.desc: It's the summer of 1980, and Björn Borg is the top tennis player in the world, dominating the sport both on and off the court. A powerful and rigorously disciplined player, there is only one obstacle in his pursuit of a record-breaking fifth Wimbledon championship: the highly talented but ferociously abrasive young American John McEnroe. With three days until the tournament begins, Borg trains religiously in his lavish Monaco home, aided by his coach and mentor Lennart and girlfriend Mariana. - Sverrir Gudnason, Shia LaBeouf, Stellan Skarsgård, Tuva Novotny, Ian Blackman (Drama)

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond is a New York City money launderer who wakes up with no memory and millions of dollars in stolen cash and drugs. He must soon scour the streets in search of answers while trying to dodge a crew of violent and crooked cops. - Liam Hemsworth, Emory Cohen, Diane Guerrero, Nickola Shreli, Suraj Sharma (Action, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Kiss the Girls
programme.desc: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova. - Morgan Freeman, Ashley Judd, Cary Elwes, Tony Goldwyn, Jay O. Sanders (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Deepwater Horizon
programme.desc: On April 20, 2010, the Deepwater Horizon drilling rig explodes in the Gulf of Mexico, igniting a massive fireball that kills several crew members. Chief electronics technician Mike Williams (Mark Wahlberg) and his colleagues find themselves fighting for survival as the heat and the flames become stifling and overwhelming. Banding together, the co-workers must use their wits to make it out alive amid all the chaos. - Mark Wahlberg, Kurt Russell, Douglas M. Griffin, James DuMont, Joe Chrest (Thriller, Action, Drama, Adventure, Biography)

programme.title: Hacksaw Ridge
programme.desc: During World War II's Battle of Okinawa, U.S. Army medic Desmond Doss (Andrew Garfield) braves bullets, grenades and snipers while single-handedly evacuating the wounded from behind enemy lines.

programme.title: The Commuter
programme.desc: In the midst of his daily commute, insurance salesman Michael McCauley is contacted by a mysterious stranger who forces him to uncover the identity of a hidden passenger on the train before the last stop.

programme.title: NHL Hockey - Utah Mammoth at Vegas Golden Knights
programme.desc: The Mammoth play the Golden Knights at T-Mobile Arena for Game 5 of the West first round. The series is tied 2-2 after Vegas won Game 4. The Golden Knights scored 5-4 behind Shea Theodore's winning goal. Utah stormed back with four unanswered goals. (Playoff sports, Hockey)

programme.title: Barron's Cove
programme.desc: A man with a violent past kidnaps the boy he holds responsible for his son's death. As he grows closer to uncovering the truth, he's left to wonder whether his pursuers are really seeking to protect the boy, or merely the secrets he keeps.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life. Still traumatized, their fragile existence is pushed to the breaking point.

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: An accident-prone daredevil (Andy Samberg) plans an outrageous stunt to raise money for lifesaving surgery for his abusive stepfather.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: An aspiring teenage rock journalist gets his big break when he follows an up-and-coming band on its tour.

programme.title: Bebe's Kids
programme.desc: Three lonely latchkey kids vent their frustrations. Based on late comic Robin Harris' stand-up routine.

programme.title: Peep World
programme.desc: Revelations arise when members (Michael C. Hall, Sarah Silverman) of a dysfunctional Jewish family gather to celebrate the patriarch's (Ron Rifkin) 70th birthday.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

programme.title: Río
programme.desc: A domesticated macaw (Jesse Eisenberg) and his human friend (Leslie Mann) travel to Rio de Janeiro to meet the last surviving female (Anne Hathaway) of his kind.

programme.title: Boys and Girls
programme.desc: Two longtime friends (Freddie Prinze Jr., Claire Forlani), each with a string of failed romances, wonder if they should date each other.

programme.title: Bebe's Kids
programme.desc: In this animated depiction of a calamitous first date, Robin Harris hits it off with the gorgeous Jamika, whom he meets at her boss' funeral. On the ride back, Harris is introduced to her well-behaved son, and asked if he wants to go with them to the amusement park the next day. Harris accepts, and arrives to find three more children joining them. Jamika is watching her friend Bebe's kids — which is the beginning of Harris' problems. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Good Boys
programme.desc: Invited to his first kissing party, 12-year-old Max asks his best friends Lucas and Thor for some much-needed help on how to pucker up. When they hit a dead end, Max decides to use his father's drone to spy on the teenage girls next door. When the boys lose the drone, they skip school and hatch a plan to retrieve it before Max's dad can figure out what happened. - Jacob Tremblay, Keith L. Williams, Brady Noon, Molly Gordon, Lil Rel Howery (Comedy)

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody... - Neve Campbell, David Arquette, Courteney Cox, Matthew Lillard, Skeet Ulrich (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead. - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, Sarah Michelle Gellar, Jamie Kennedy (Horror, Comedy)

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s). - David Arquette, Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox Arquette, Patrick Dempsey, Scott Foley (Horror, Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson, Jason Lee, Patrick Fugit (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama)

programme.title: Raging Grace
programme.desc: Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart. - Max Eigenmann, Jaeden Boadilla, Leanne Best, David Hayman, Oliver Wellington (Horror, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: The Wedding Banquet
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things soon get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with plans for an extravagant Korean wedding banquet. - Bowen Yang, Lily Gladstone, Kelly Marie Tran, Han Gi-chan, Bobo Le (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration. - Amanda Plummer, Ulrich Thomsen, Costas Mandylor, James Russo, Barkhad Abdi (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend. - Jon Hamm, Kyle MacLachlan, Marcia Gay Harden, Roy Wood Jr., Annie Mumolo (Comedy, Mystery)

programme.title: Kinky Boots
programme.desc: After his father's demise, Charlie Price inherits the family business, a shoe factory in Northampton, England. He is not interested in shoes, and the factory is in such dire financial straits that he must lay off 15 employees. However, a fortuitous encounter with a transvestite cabaret singer inspires Charlie to save the factory from closure by producing erotic footwear, much to the chagrin of the workers. - Joel Edgerton, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Sarah-Jane Potts, Jemima Rooper, Linda Bassett (Comedy drama, LGBTQ, Music)

programme.title: The Boys Are Back
programme.desc: After the untimely passing of his second wife, Joe (Clive Owen) must deal with his grief as he strives to find a way to raise his sons alone. The boys, Artie and Harry, are trying to cope with their own emotional baggage, so the three decide to throw convention to the wind and live by the words "just say yes." When things go wrong, Joe must find a way to behave more like a parent while maintaining the joys of a more-carefree life. - Clive Owen, Emma Booth, Laura Fraser, George MacKay, Nicholas McAnulty (Comedy drama)

programme.title: Overdrive
programme.desc: A notorious crime boss forces two legendary car thieves to steal a vehicle to win back their freedom. Joined by two beautiful women, the team has one week to pull off the daring heist or risk losing everything, including their lives. - Scott Eastwood, Freddie Thorp, Ana de Armas, Gaia Weiss, Simon Abkarian (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Staten Island Summer
programme.desc: Danny and Frank work as lifeguards for the summer and make plans to throw the wildest party of the season. - Ashley Greene, Kate Walsh, Gina Gershon, Jim Gaffigan, Graham Phillips (Comedy)

programme.title: The Kings of Summer
programme.desc: Three teenagers (Nick Robinson, Gabriel Basso, Moises Arias) carry out a plan to leave their dysfunctional parents, build a house in the woods and live off the land. - Nick Robinson, Gabriel Basso, Moises Arias, Nick Offerman, Megan Mullally (Comedy drama, Adventure)

programme.title: Men, Women & Children
programme.desc: Like many Americans, average suburbanite Don Truby and his 15-year-old son use the Internet for information, communication and viewing pornography. Don's son Chris also maintains sexually explicit conversations with classmate Hannah, an aspiring actress whose mother posts pictures of her daughter on a modeling Website. In sharp contrast, overprotective mom Patricia Beltmeyer does everything in her power to protect her daughter from the digital age. - Rosemarie DeWitt, Jennifer Garner, Judy Greer, Dean Norris, Adam Sandler (Drama)

programme.title: Everybody Wants Some!!
programme.desc: In 1980 Texas, a college freshman meets his new baseball teammates, an unruly group of disco-dancing, skirt-chasing partiers. - Will Brittain, Zoey Deutch, Ryan Guzman, Tyler Hoechlin, Blake Jenner (Comedy)

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street. - Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson, Sinbad, Abe Vigoda, Shar Jackson (Comedy)

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place. - Matthew McConaughey, Sarah Jessica Parker, Zooey Deschanel, Justin Bartha, Bradley Cooper (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Hardball
programme.desc: Conor (Keanu Reeves) is a ticket scalper, gambler and, now, Little League coach for a rag-tag team of kids in one of the toughest part of Chicago. He's no role model, but his buddy Jimmy won't help him pay off his gambling debts unless Conor coaches Jimmy's corporately sponsored team. Surprising even himself, Conor becomes attached to his players -- and to their attractive schoolteacher (Diane Lane) -- and drawn into their tough and sometimes tragic lives. - Keanu Reeves, Diane Lane, John Hawkes, Bryan C. Hearne, Julian Griffith (Drama, Comedy)

programme.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
programme.desc: In the long-running animated series' second feature film, the focus is on the show's perennial second banana, Chuckie (Christine Cavanaugh). Dads Stu (Jack Riley) and Chaz (Michael Bell) are unexpectedly sent to Euro-Reptarland in Paris, where the animatronic dinosaurs they built for the amusement park are malfunctioning, much to the displeasure of manager Coco La Bouche (Susan Sarandon). When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. - Michael Bell (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy)

programme.title: Bran Nue Dae
programme.desc: A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey. - Rocky McKenzie, Jessica Mauboy, Ernie Dingo, Geoffrey Rush, Magda Szubanski (Drama, Comedy, Musical)

programme.title: End of Sentence
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland. - John Hawkes, Logan Lerman, Sarah Bolger, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson, Andrea Irvine (Drama)

programme.title: Middle School: The Worst Years of My Life
programme.desc: Rafe Khatchadorian (Griffin Gluck) has an epic imagination and a slight problem with authority, and these things collide when he transfers to a middle school where students are expected to follow the rules. This doesn't sit well with Rafe. With help from his new friend Leo (Thomas Barbusca), the mischievous lad concocts schemes to drive his tyrannical principal (Andy Daly) crazy while also using his charm and wits to impress a girl (Isabela Moner) and battle the bullies. - Griffin Gluck, Lauren Graham, Rob Riggle, Thomas Barbusca, Andy Daly (Children, Comedy, Animated)

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress. - Tsemaye Bob-Egbe, Natey Jones, Jo Wheatley, Alexandra Burke, Michael Junior Onafowokan (Drama)

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever. - Katherine Heigl, Tom Wilkinson, Linda Emond, Grace Gummer, Alexis Bledel (Romantic comedy, LGBTQ, Drama)

programme.title: Bran Nue Dae
programme.desc: A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey. - Rocky McKenzie, Jessica Mauboy, Ernie Dingo, Geoffrey Rush, Magda Szubanski (Drama, Comedy, Musical)

programme.title: Blue Story
programme.desc: Best friends Timmy and Marco go to the same high school but live in neighboring London boroughs. When Marco gets beaten up by one of Timmy's friends, the two boys wind up on rival sides of a gang war in which there are no winners, only victims.

programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period. (Sports talk, Football)

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: In the 1980s, geeky Adam uses a video camera to document his family's crazy life. His mother, Beverly, is overprotective and lacks boundaries, while his dad has a hot temper and finds it difficult to parent without screaming. Rounding out the clan are Adam's terrifying sister, Erica; his older brother, Barry, who has middle-child syndrome; and the family's beloved grandfather, Al "Pops" Solomon. Pops is responsible for wild antics, including offering drinks to Barry and teaching Adam about the ways of love -- which create more chaos in an already high-strung family. - Wendi McLendon-Covey, Sean Giambrone, Troy Gentile, Hayley Orrantia, Sam Lerner (Sitcom)

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Samantha, a cheerful freelance journalist, and Jay, an up-and-coming chef from the city, throw both caution and money to the wind when they decide to convert a huge run-down country estate they inherited into a bed and breakfast -- only to find it's inhabited by the many spirits of deceased residents. The departed souls are a close-knit, eclectic group that includes a saucy Prohibition-era lounge singer, a pompous 1700's Militiaman, a '60s hippie fond of hallucinogens and an overly upbeat '80s scout troop leader. If the spirits were anxious about the commotion a renovation and B&B will create in their home, it's nothing compared to when they realize Samantha is the first live person who can see and hear them. - Rose McIver, Utkarsh Ambudkar, Brandon Scott Jones, Richie Moriarty, Danielle Pinnock (Sitcom, Paranormal, Fantasy, Comedy, Thriller)

programme.title: Nation's Dumbest
programme.desc: "Nation's Dumbest" is a celebrity competition series with a twisted premise: it's the only game show where winning is the last thing anyone wants. Famous faces are sent back to "summer school" and must relive the highs and humiliations of school life through a mix of brain-teasing pop quizzes, fast-paced physical challenges, and tests built on long-buried classroom knowledge. Rather than striving for a top prize, contestants battle to stay out of last place, because the worst performer is publicly humiliated with the unwanted title of "The Nation's Dumbest." Each week, the "smartest" celebrity graduates and leaves the competition, narrowing the field until a high-stakes final exam determines who ultimately fails their way to the infamous crown. programme.desc: S3E21 - A 1945 case involves an ambitious reporter demoted to writing trivial advice columns.

programme.title: Cold Case - The River
programme.desc: S3E22 - A 1984 shooting case reopens when a new witness comes forward; Lilly follows a lead into the gambling world.

programme.title: Charmed - Animal Pragmatism
programme.desc: S2E13 - Phoebe attempts to reverse the spell that turned animals into good-looking dates for her study group, creating a virtual zoo at the club.

programme.title: Charmed - Pardon My Past
programme.desc: S2E14 - Phoebe travels to 1924 and confronts an immortal warlock (Tyler Christopher) who forced her to destroy Prue and Piper in a past life.

programme.title: Charmed - Give Me a Sign
programme.desc: S2E15 - Criminal mastermind Bane (Antonio Sabato Jr.) kidnaps Prue and makes her protect him from a powerful demon.

programme.title: Charmed - Murphy's Luck
programme.desc: S2E16 - After Prue rescues an unlucky woman who is being tormented by a Darklighter, she is beset by telepathic messages telling her to commit suicide.

programme.title: Charmed - How to Make a Quilt Out of Americans
programme.desc: S2E17 - An old family friend appeals to Piper, Phoebe and Prue to stop a demon who steals the skin from corpses; Piper doesn't want to be a witch anymore.

programme.title: Cold Case - Revenge
programme.desc: S2E16 - When a priest comes forward with a person's confession related to the death of a 9-year-old boy, police reopen the case, and the boy's uncle becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: Cold Case - Schadenfreude
programme.desc: S2E17 - The rare ring of a long-dead Philadelphia woman is found on the finger of a dead junkie, prompting Rush and the team to reopen the 1984 murder case.

programme.title: Cold Case - Ravaged
programme.desc: S2E18 - The investigation into an accidental death reopens when the victim's sister asserts she may have been murdered by members of a fraternity.

programme.title: Cold Case - Strange Fruit
programme.desc: S2E19 - When a black teen makes friends with his white peers, despite his family being a target of racism, he ends up a murder victim, and detectives must sift through a slew of suspects to find the killer.

programme.title: Cold Case - Kensington
programme.desc: S2E20 - Rush and the team reopen the case of an optimistic young mill worker who was murdered in a town filled with despair.

programme.title: Godzilla: King of the Monsters
programme.desc: Humanity's existence hangs in the balance when the mighty Godzilla collides with Mothra, Rodan and the three-headed monster King Ghidorah.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
programme.desc: Fearsome monsters Godzilla and Kong square off in an epic battle for the ages. The initial confrontation between the two titans -- instigated by unseen forces -- is only the beginning of the mystery that lies deep within the core of the planet.

programme.title: Dunkman World Championship - Group Stage A (New)
programme.desc: S2E1 - China's top dunker Dengxing Chen headlines the opening round as six elite competitors battle in Group Stage A for a chance to advance toward the Dunkman World Championship.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench
programme.desc: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. - Jason Statham, Wu Jing, Sophia Cai, Page Kennedy, Sergio Peris-Mencheta (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Cold Case - Creatures of the Night
programme.desc: S2E21 - Rush and Valens try to connect a murder from 1977 to a serial killer about to be released from prison on a legal technicality. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Thom Barry, Jeremy Ratchford (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - The War at Home
programme.desc: S4E2 - A 2004 case involving the disappearance of a female war veteran reopens when her prosthetic arm is found in a river. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Sandhogs
programme.desc: S4E3 - Bones found in a subway tunnel are identified as those of a sandhog miner who disappeared in 1947. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Charmed - Chick Flick
programme.desc: S2E18 - A demon emancipates celluloid monsters from the confines of the silver screen to kill Phoebe, Piper and Prue. - Shannen Doherty, Holly Marie Combs, Alyssa Milano, T.W. King (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Charmed - Ex Libris
programme.desc: S2E19 - Phoebe helps the ghost of a student who was killed to prevent the publication of her thesis on evil; the Goo Goo Dolls perform at Piper's nightclub. - Shannen Doherty, Holly Marie Combs, Alyssa Milano, T.W. King (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Charmed - Astral Monkey
programme.desc: S2E20 - A doctor acquires the witches' powers during a blood transfusion, then seeks to save his dying sister. - Shannen Doherty, Holly Marie Combs, Alyssa Milano, T.W. King (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Charmed - Apocalypse Not
programme.desc: S2E21 - When Prue is sucked into a vortex with an apocalyptic horseman, Phoebe and Piper are forced to choose between saving their sister and saving the world. - Shannen Doherty, Holly Marie Combs, Alyssa Milano, T.W. King (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Charmed - Be Careful What You Witch For
programme.desc: S2E22 - The Infernal Council sends a genie (French Stewart) to destroy the Power of Three by granting each sister a wish. - Shannen Doherty, Holly Marie Combs, Alyssa Milano, T.W. King (Drama, Fantasy, Mystery, Comedy, Romance)

programme.title: Cold Case - Creatures of the Night
programme.desc: S2E21 - Rush and Valens try to connect a murder from 1977 to a serial killer about to be released from prison on a legal technicality. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Thom Barry, Jeremy Ratchford (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Best Friends
programme.desc: S2E22 - When a truck containing human bones is retrieved from the Delaware River, Rush and Valens link the truck to a Prohibition bootlegger and believe the remains are those of a woman who went missing in 1932. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Thom Barry, Jeremy Ratchford (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - The Woods
programme.desc: S2E23 - The discovery of nine human skulls prompts Rush to look again at a serial killer she was unable to put away months earlier, flushing him from hiding for a final showdown. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Thom Barry, Jeremy Ratchford (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Family
programme.desc: S3E1 - Rush and Valens unravel the mystery of a girl's parentage and the death of the man assumed to be her father; the detectives are ambivalent about a new member of the squad, Josie Sutton (Sarah Brown). - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Thom Barry, Jeremy Ratchford (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - The Promise
programme.desc: S3E2 - An overweight, reclusive coed dies in a fraternity house fire, and Lilly discovers a photo of her being held down and forced to drink. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Thom Barry, Jeremy Ratchford (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
programme.desc: Kong and his protectors undertake a perilous journey to find his true home. Along for the ride is Jia, an orphaned girl who has a unique and powerful bond with the mighty beast. However, they soon find themselves in the path of an enraged Godzilla as he cuts a swath of destruction across the globe. The initial confrontation between the two titans -- instigated by unseen forces -- is only the beginning of the mystery that lies deep within the core of the planet. - Alexander Skarsgård, Millie Bobby Brown, Rebecca Hall, Brian Tyree Henry, Shun Oguri (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: Scientists, soldiers and adventurers unite to explore a mythical, uncharted island in the Pacific Ocean. Cut off from everything they know, they venture into the domain of the mighty Kong, igniting the ultimate battle between man and nature. As their mission of discovery soon becomes one of survival, they must fight to escape from a primal world where humanity does not belong. - Tom Hiddleston, Samuel L. Jackson, Brie Larson, John C. Reilly, John Goodman (Adventure, Action, Science fiction, Fantasy)

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. - Anya Taylor-Joy, Chris Hemsworth, Tom Burke, Lachy Hulme, Charlee Fraser (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Once home to the most advanced civilization on Earth, the city of Atlantis is now an underwater kingdom ruled by the power-hungry King Orm. With a vast army at his disposal, Orm plans to conquer the remaining oceanic people -- and then the surface world. Standing in his way is Aquaman, Orm's half-human, half-Atlantean brother and true heir to the throne. With help from royal counselor Vulko, Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan and embrace his destiny as protector of the deep. - Jason Momoa, Amber Heard, Willem Dafoe, Patrick Wilson, Nicole Kidman (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction)

programme.title: Cold Case - Baby Blues
programme.desc: S4E4 - Lilly reopens a 1982 case involving a baby that died of SIDS; she investigates the baby's older brother, who believes he had something to do with the death. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Saving Sammy
programme.desc: S4E5 - Lilly investigates the 2003 case of an autistic boy who witnessed his parents' murder. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - Static
programme.desc: S4E6 - When the 1958 suicide of a celebrated Philadelphia disc jockey is discovered to have been a murder, Rush and the team must find the truth of this public persona's private life. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Cold Case - The Key
programme.desc: S4E7 - After discovering new evidence, detective Jeffries re-opens a 1979 murder case in which he promised the victim's daughter that he would find her mother's killer. - Kathryn Morris, Danny Pino, John Finn, Jeremy Ratchford, Thom Barry (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: FBI - Fire and Rain
programme.desc: S4E8 - A widow is shocked that her new "boyfriend" is the manipulative leader of a terrorist group planning an attack; Scola is reminded of his brother's death on 9/11; Tiffany worries about his emotional choices during the investigation. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Unfinished Business
programme.desc: S4E9 - After Rina is critically wounded while heading to work with Jubal, the team makes the chilling discovery that a vengeful Vargas orchestrated the shooting from behind bars and continues to target the rest of their team and their loved ones. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Fostered
programme.desc: S4E10 - As the team investigates a string of jewelry store robberies that culminate in a double murder, they uncover a connection to a 16-year-old boy trying to survive the foster care system. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Grief
programme.desc: S4E11 - The team searches for an abducted college coed; Jubal has a tense encounter with Rina's mother. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Under Pressure
programme.desc: S4E12 - Maggie goes undercover working in a bar to investigate an anti-government group that regularly gathers there; a single father on the periphery of the group begins to fear he's in danger of becoming collateral damage. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Pride & Prejudice
programme.desc: S4E13 - When a Muslim college student and his younger brother are murdered, the team connects with the outraged imam of OA's former mosque, who insists the victims were wrongly targeted as terrorists. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Ambition
programme.desc: S4E14 - The team investigates an extremist gun group after an anti-gun lobbyist building is bombed; SAC Bashar dangles a possible promotion for OA. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Scar Tissue
programme.desc: S4E15 - The team realize they have a cross-country serial killer on their hands; the case has ties to Isobel's father, Robert, and his hotel, leading to revelations about their fractured relationship. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)

programme.title: FBI - Protective Details
programme.desc: S4E16 - After an immigration agent is fatally shot at a hockey game, the team attempts to find the shooter, who they believe may also be targeting Congressman Curtis Grange, who was at the same game. - Missy Peregrym, Zeeko Zaki, Jeremy Sisto, Alana De La Garza, John Boyd (Crime drama, Action, Thriller)
